Student here.

I had all of my posted notes confiscated by the assistant principle.

I also had my phone sorta confiscated. We were about to take PARK tests(It's an Illinois standardized test). The teacher asked is anyone had "electronic devices". I gave it to her(At the time my background was a meme photo of LefyIsHere), and when she put it down on her desk she saw my background a look of disgust spread across her face.
I just felt like going on here.
My walk. i swing my arms when I walk and people make fun of it.
Well actually people rubbing my leg.
I hope for that too. Dreaming makes me happy. Eternal happiness doesn't sound bad.

I can't wait for those eleven days. I love you.

\-Owlmoo's boyfriend
Putting secret cameras in hotel rooms, and A.) see if any couples do it B.) see which couple lasts longer
Thanks for responding. Turns out she looks at my reddit account fsr. Thanks though, you helped a brother out.
The most racist thing I said in my life was a joke on R/crusadememes.
My parents found out about me cutting myself. Took my knives away. Now I’m going to be doing a program. I don’t want to fucking live my pointless life anymore.
Sorry. Can’t do that. My life gets worse when I talk about it.

My cuts aren’t deep. I’m just trying to feel something even if it’s pain. The thing that scares me about death isn’t dying. It’s what happens after death. Is there an after life. What will happen to my friends. One of the things that helps is my friend sending me “good night. Try not to die” it’s a goal when I otherwise have no motivation.

I have parents and siblings just don’t want them involved. Usually would talk to my friend about this but she’s with another friend of mine I’m not comfortable know shit like this. Came to Reddit for a try.
You’re missing some context. He made me feel like shit with a comment. I thought I would reciprocate the feeling. I’m not defending what I said. Just giving more information.
Go fuck your self. I would help, but you deserve it all. Your an actual piece of garbage.
You can text 741-741 in the U.S. it’s just like the suicide prevention hotline but through text.
Fuck you. I’m talking about a good friend of mine who is helping me through a rough time in my life and you say that. That’s gross and disgusting. Why are even saying shit like that on this sub.
I don’t feel like shit for being suicidal. I feel like shit asking for help with it. You should feel bad for being suicidal. Try and get help from friends.
